name: chatter
description: Chatter — a local-first chat playground. Ships as a website (Vercel) and as an Android APK (Capacitor).

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
